author: wenger88
quote:
Worst and most disappointing game ever.
The story, writing and characters are soulless, even worse than modern Ubislop games. Jason and Lucia are by far the worst protagonists ever. Jason is a boring soulless cuck and Lucia is a whining girlboss that can't get anything right. Both just horrible personalities.
The game is restricting you from core features and indeed GRAND THEFT AUTO. Just boring bunch of silly nonsense. You can tell who made this woke slop.
Performance issues and bugs are really bad. At least CP2077 had the first mission polished before being a disaster.
The map is great, that's expected considering GTA online is going to be milked for the next decade on.
Graphics will be better on PC.
I would give it 1/10 but that's far too much considering 2 billion dollars and 13 years.
I remember people saying this game better be the most revolutionary and perfect game by a mile. It's not even close to that
The hate is justified.
DO NOT BUY!!!
